title: klasea integrifolia
intro: Klasea integrifolia, commonly known as Indian spikenard, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Boraginaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. Klasea integrifolia contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
